clue.text: Politician allegedly partying in underwear?

definitions.meaning: Boris ..., the Prime Minister accused of attending lockdown parties at Downing Street
a slang word for the penis, something found in underwear

explanation.surface: A gossip asks whether a politician was seen partying in his underwear.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the second, cheeky sense: the answer is also a slang word for the male member.
explanation.definitionFit: Boris Johnson faced the Partygate allegations; the same surname is a vulgar slang term for the penis.

clue.text: Old carpenter's record breaking banter?

indicators.note: the record breaking the banter means it splits that word open and sits inside it

parts.note: to josh is to tease or banter
EP is an extended-play record

explanation.surface: An ancient woodworker's record is interrupting some light-hearted chat.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Gospels, Joseph, husband of Mary, worked as a carpenter in Nazareth.

clue.text: The Endlessly Good Cooked Snack

indicators.note: cooked means prepared or doctored, so the letters are reworked
without its end, so the last letter of the word the is dropped

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Reads like a grand title for the perfect prepared snack, capitals and all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Endlessly' trims THE to TH; 'Cooked' rearranges TH plus GOOD.
explanation.definitionFit: A sausage served in a bread roll is a classic quick snack bought from street stalls.

clue.text: One such as eats mice potentially?

definitions.text: One such as eats mice potentially?

indicators.note: potentially means these letters could become something else when rearranged

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Asks for an example of a creature that would catch and devour mice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potentially' rearranges AS EATS MICE, and the whole clue also describes the answer: a cat that eats mice.
explanation.definitionFit: A Siamese is a domestic cat breed, and cats are the classic mouse hunters.

clue.text: Warm and comfortable homes: scores around south

indicators.note: the scores word goes around the south letter, enclosing it

parts.note: to net is to score a goal

explanation.surface: An estate agent's listing: cosy houses, with a tally of how many lie to the south.
explanation.walkthrough: 'around' puts NETS round S.
explanation.definitionFit: A nest is a snug shelter, and figuratively any cosy home or retreat.

clue.text: Overact before noon in greeting sheepish mate?

indicators.note: one piece sits in the greeting, inside its two letters

parts.note: hi is an informal greeting
AM means before noon (ante meridiem)
a tup is a ram, the mate of a ewe

explanation.surface: A melodramatic morning greeting addressed to a bashful friend.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sheepish mate' is a playful way of saying the male partner of a ewe.
explanation.definitionFit: To ham it up is an idiom for performing with exaggerated, theatrical gestures.

clue.text: Resort makes old man better, hospital after time admitted

indicators.note: admitted, as to a ward, means let inside, so these letters go inside the healing word

parts.note: heals means makes better, and pa is an informal word for father, one's old man

indicators.note: the hospital letter comes after the time letter

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hospital on maps and signs

explanation.surface: A retreat that restores an elderly man, with a spell in hospital first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'admitted' puts T then H ('after') inside HEALS, and PA follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A health spa is a resort where people go for treatments and relaxation.

clue.text: See 24
Some born together: Eliot, Eliot and Eliot?

definitions.text: Some born together: Eliot, Eliot and Eliot?

parts.words: Some born together: Eliot, Eliot and Eliot?
parts.note: three of the initials of T. S. Eliot make a trio of the same letter pair, read as a word for babies of one birth

explanation.walkthrough: Each Eliot stands for the initials TS of T. S. Eliot, so three of them read TRIPLE TS.
explanation.definitionFit: Triplets are three children delivered in the same birth.

clue.text: Drug dealer sending unknown ale drinkers up to pub

parts.note: PH is the abbreviation for public house

indicators.note: sending something up, in a down clue, turns it backwards
in a down clue up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: Y is a mathematical unknown
CAMRA is the Campaign for Real Ale, a British group of beer enthusiasts

explanation.surface: A dealer dispatching an unknown group of beer drinkers to the local.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'sending ... up' reads the unknown and the beer campaigners bottom to top, beneath the pub.
explanation.definitionFit: A pharmacy legitimately sells medicines, so it is a lawful drug dealer.

clue.text: Buddhist collection is just great when used 15

indicators.note: clue 15 is the word for at even intervals, so every other letter of these words is used

explanation.surface: Praises a Buddhist anthology as simply wonderful when studied often.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used 15' points to the answer at 15, REGULARLY: take every other letter of IS JUST GREAT, starting with S.
explanation.definitionFit: A sutra is a scripture or collection of teachings attributed to the Buddha.

clue.text: Society to suspend rail travelling in ideal place

parts.note: to hang something is to suspend it

indicators.note: travelling suggests the letters are on the move into a new order

explanation.surface: A railway society plans to halt the line through a beauty spot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'travelling' rearranges RAIL to RILA.
explanation.definitionFit: Shangri-La, the hidden valley in James Hilton's Lost Horizon, stands for any earthly paradise.

clue.text: Enquire too intrusively, holding obvious pose, leaning

indicators.note: the prying word holds the other pieces within it

parts.note: to pry is to enquire nosily
open means plain, obvious
to sit is to pose for a portrait

explanation.surface: A nosy questioner strikes a blatant pose while leaning over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaning' looks like physical posture but is the tendency sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A propensity is an inclination or tendency, a leaning towards something.

clue.text: Some abstemious luminaries in Number Ten? Hardly!

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Sneers that teetotal celebrities would hardly be found at Downing Street.
explanation.definitionFit: Number Ten Downing Street is a grand official residence; squalid housing is its opposite.

clue.text: Class this month one impossible to change

parts.note: a set is a class or group
inst., instant, is an old business abbreviation for this month
taken as written

explanation.surface: Reads like a school notice that this month's class is fixed.
explanation.walkthrough: INST (instant) is old commercial correspondence shorthand for the current month.
explanation.definitionFit: Something set in stone is fixed and unalterable, like an inscription carved in rock.

clue.text: Mushroom en croûte is splattered round 24 6 perhaps

indicators.note: the rearranged letters go round the mushroom
splattered means scattered about, so these letters are thrown into a new order

parts.note: a cep is a porcini mushroom

explanation.surface: A culinary disaster: a mushroom pastry burst open all over someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'splattered' rearranges CROUTE IS into EUROSTIC; 'round' wraps it round CEP. 'en croûte' is a cooking term, here just surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Jacob Rees-Mogg is a prominent Brexit supporter, an example of someone hostile to the European Union.

clue.text: Characters from Rye thus observed in Argyle?

definitions.text: Characters from Rye thus observed in Argyle?

parts.words: Characters from Rye thus observed in Argyle?
parts.note: the letters R, Y, E turn up at every second position in the word Argyle

explanation.walkthrough: In ARGYLE the letters R, Y and E sit in the 2nd, 4th and 6th places, spaced at even intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: Regularly means at fixed, evenly spaced intervals, as these letters appear.

clue.text: Raw joint serious hack divides

indicators.note: the hack goes inside the joint word, splitting it in two

parts.note: united means joint, combined
ED is the editor, the senior journalist in charge of the hacks

explanation.surface: A tough reporter splits some uncooked meat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serious hack' is the newsroom's senior figure, the editor.
explanation.definitionFit: Raw copy or footage is material that has not been corrected or cut.

clue.text: Denomination one in argument against procedure

indicators.note: the denomination and one go in the argument word

parts.note: a con is an argument against, as in pros and cons
a sect is a religious denomination
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A religious group objects to a certain course of action.
explanation.definitionFit: A Caesarean section is a surgical operation to deliver a baby.

clue.text: Student traitor? Country needs one for a minister dismissed

parts.note: NUS is the National Union of Students
a rat is a betrayer

indicators.note: one is put for the letter a, replacing it

parts.note: Ghana is a country in West Africa
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A student turncoat, and a nation needing one person to replace a sacked minister.
explanation.walkthrough: GHANA becomes GHANI when 'for' swaps its final A for I.
explanation.definitionFit: Nusrat Ghani is a British Conservative MP who said she was sacked as a transport minister in 2020.

clue.text: Are they people who speak for Dorothy Leigh?

definitions.meaning: Dorothy L. ..., the crime writer who created Lord Peter Wimsey

explanation.walkthrough: Dorothy Leigh is a deliberately full spelling of the middle initial in Dorothy L. Sayers.
explanation.definitionFit: Speakers are literally sayers; the novelist's surname happens to match.

clue.text: Rule to include singular advice for 1 Across?

indicators.note: the rule word is made to take in the singular letter

parts.note: to reign is to rule
S is the grammatical abbreviation for singular

explanation.surface: A ruler, singular in power, receives a hint aimed at a beleaguered prime minister.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to include' puts S inside REIGN.
explanation.definitionFit: The counsel to Boris Johnson was to quit office, which he did in 2022.

clue.text: Met leader, having to leave early: another 1 Across?

definitions.text: Met leader, having to leave early
definitions.meaning: Cressida ..., Metropolitan Police commissioner who quit before her term ended
another slang word for the penis, like johnson

explanation.walkthrough: The Met is London's Metropolitan Police. 1 Across's slang sense is the penis, and this answer is a cruder synonym.
explanation.definitionFit: Dame Cressida Dick resigned as Met commissioner in 2022; the surname is also vulgar slang for penis.

clue.text: SEALs experience narrow escape from danger

parts.note: to seal something is to close it, so seals means closes
to have is to experience, as in have a good time

explanation.surface: US Navy commandos go through a near miss on a mission.
explanation.walkthrough: SEALs looks like the US special forces; it is the verb meaning closes.
explanation.definitionFit: A close shave is an idiom for a near miss, a lucky avoidance of disaster.

clue.text: Scottish League One? Team's First Division

parts.note: SPL was the Scottish Premier League in football
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: the first letter of the team word is taken

explanation.surface: Football talk about a Scottish League One team in the First Division.
explanation.walkthrough: 'League One' and 'First Division' are football tiers, but here 'One' is I and 'First' takes T.
explanation.definitionFit: A split is a division or rift between parties.

clue.text: MP backing 1 Across — more eggs thrown

indicators.note: thrown suggests the letters are tossed about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Angry protesters pelt a loyal supporter of the prime minister with more eggs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thrown' rearranges MORE EGGS.
explanation.definitionFit: Jacob Rees-Mogg was a Conservative MP and cabinet minister loyal to Boris Johnson.

clue.text: Male doctor within hearing two-faced? Three!

indicators.note: the male doctor goes within the hearing word

parts.note: a trial is a court hearing
he is the male pronoun

explanation.surface: A male doctor at a court hearing is accused of hypocrisy, then of worse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'two-faced? Three!' corrects itself: the solid has three faces, not two.
explanation.definitionFit: Trihedral describes a figure formed by three planes meeting, so having three faces.

clue.text: Daggers bishop plunged into old priest

indicators.note: the bishop is plunged into the other letters, ending up inside them

parts.note: Eli is the priest in the Old Testament who raised Samuel
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: A violent scene: a bishop stabs an elderly clergyman with knives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plunged into' puts B between O and ELI.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeli are the dagger symbols used in print to mark footnotes or doubtful passages.

clue.text: Extremely disorderly and disagreeable house

indicators.note: the extremes, the first and last letters, of the word disorderly

parts.note: nasty means unpleasant, disagreeable

explanation.surface: Describes a home that is utterly messy and unpleasant.
explanation.definitionFit: A royal house is a ruling family, a line of succession such as the House of Windsor.

clue.text: Disloyalty Tories' principal motivation

indicators.note: principal means chief or leading, so the leading letter of Tories' is taken

parts.note: a reason is a motive or motivation

explanation.surface: Asks what drives a party's members to betray each other.
explanation.definitionFit: Treason is betrayal of one's country or ruler, the gravest disloyalty.
